text:
melissa: Heads-up everyone — Dedicated capacity update: we are starting a phased rollout of NVIDIA A800-based pools in us-west-2 and adding a new availability zone in eu-central-1 for Dedicated customers. This includes new reservation SKUs and a short migration window. :tada:
arjun: Quick tech notes — A800s run our latest 2.3 runtime. Kernel/driver matrix validated, supports mixed-precision and our 4-bit quant paths. MIG not enabled by default on these pools (we found fragmentation hurt throughput).
sara: Product note — new SKUs will appear as `dedicated.a800.xlarge`/`dedicated.a800.2x` in the Console; pricing is live for committed contracts starting next billing cycle. Current Dedicated customers can opt into the A800 pool during reservation changes.
cara: Ops plan — we'll enable us-west-2 pool in soft-launch at 2024-08-15 02:00 UTC (canary customers only) and open eu-central-1 for beta on 2024-08-22 07:00 UTC. Expected brief control-plane flapping during cutover (<10m). No data-plane reboots expected for existing Dedicated nodes.
melissa: If you manage customer migrations, please review the migration checklist (link: https://intranet.redwood/dedicated/a800-rollout). Key items: update client runtime to >=2.3, review model quantization guidance, and verify autoscale policies.
arjun: Example migration CLI for reserved pool move:
```
# move reservation to a800 pool
redwood reservations update --id rsv-1234 --pool dedicated.a800.xlarge --start 2024-08-16
```
melissa: Capacity note — initial pools are limited. We will enforce per-account quotas to ensure fair onboarding. If you have enterprise customers needing bulk capacity, please fill out the priority form: https://redwood-forms/priority-capacity.
capacity-bot: [capacity-bot] Pool update: us-west-2:a800 pool health=GREEN, available_units=48, reserved_units=12. eu-central-1:a800 pool health=YELLOW, available_units=10, reserved_units=0.
sara: Billing ops — customers moved mid-cycle will see pro-rated charges. Finance expects these to reconcile automatically; reach out if you see anomalies.
cara: Post-mortem toggle: we'll run a focused SRE smoke window 24h after each region enablement. Please ping #eng-oncall if you see anomalies.
melissa: TL;DR: new A800 Dedicated pools in us-west-2 and eu-central-1, phased rollout with canaries, follow the checklist, expect limited initial capacity and per-account quotas. Reach out to me or @arjun with questions. :wave:
